Subject: [pve-smart-alert] WARNING pve1: pve-smart-alert: notification transport degraded

PVE SMART Alert on pve1 has a problem of its own.

Host:       pve1 (cluster: lab)

Findings:
  WARNING   tool.transport_degraded  new
            Notification transport: the notify bridge is missing at
            /usr/libexec/pve-smart-alert/notify-bridge; notifications are sent
            as mail to root, without their severity

What to do:
  Run pve-smart-alert doctor to see why the notify bridge fails.

pve-smart-alert 0.4.0 on pve1
